rows.formula: Let N be the item count, K the number of distinct level-1 codes in the exported table, c = c_ref > 0 the frozen reference curvature, tau = tau_ref > 0 its frozen temperature, o = 0 the ball origin. For every item h let s_h be the reference source vector and t_h its target vector; map to the Poincare ball B_c = {x : c||x||^2 < 1} by x_h = exp_0^c(s_h), y_h = exp_0^c(t_h) (identity if the reference already emits ball points). Poincare distance: d_c(x,y) = c^{-1/2} arcosh( 1 + 2c||x-y||^2 / ((1-c||x||^2)(1-c||y||^2)) ). Gromov product (common-ancestor similarity) about o: G_c(x,y) = (x|y)_o = 1/2

rows.title: Cross-fitted full-negative expected-rank of the level-1 bucket, queried by the geodesic barycentre of the user's whole training history.
rows.formula:
Work in the frozen reference's ball rescaled to unit curvature (c=1) by x -> sqrt(c_ref)*x; this is a fixed isometry, not a parameter. Let d(.,.) be that Poincare geodesic distance, and let Bary(S) be the Karcher/Frechet barycentre of a finite set S in the ball (the point minimising the sum of squared d). Let b(i) be the level-1 SID code of item i, and let the frozen reference give a source point s_i and a target point t_i per item (same ball).
